correctness.rationale: Cyclic block translation acts freely on (3n-1)-subsets, yielding n|B. Adjacent-binomial ratio translates bn+1 divisibility exactly into 3n|B. Kummer enforces 3^{v3(n)+1}|B whenever 3 does not divide bn+1. If it does, Lucas base-three digit dominance characterizes every failure: b mod 3 gives no failures or an immediate one; if b=1 mod3 the low v3(b+2) digits force the sharp threshold (3^s+1)/2 and the matching witness has nonzero Lucas product. Exact integer tests were replayed; finite tests are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The f(a,b) invariant was expressly introduced to measure the first failure of binomial divisibility; this gives its full natural fixed-a=3 classification. The sharp, unbounded family along b=3^s-2 demonstrates meaningful p-adic arithmetic structure not resolved by existing generic bounds. This is a motivated complete classification, not a one-off small numerical check.
